load_bearing_forks.curt_surface: trace-reversed vertical (4,6) plus horizontal (1,3), reported as total (7,7)
load_bearing_forks.active_repo_surface: trace-reversed symmetric fibre (6,4) plus base (3,1), reported as total (9,5)
load_bearing_forks.rule: the ordered-pair sum (4,6)+(1,3) is not literally (7,7); a sign-order/dual convention must be supplied, and no spinor, Hodge, Krein, chirality, or index result transfers without a typed isometry/Clifford bridge

load_bearing_forks.active_repo_surface: right-quaternionic/Krein presentation with Sp(32,32;H), possibly as an additional reduction inside a larger complex pseudo-unitary container
load_bearing_forks.rule: U(64,64) is not equal to Sp(32,32;H); C0 must decide compatible reduction versus genuinely different carrier before either is made exclusive

load_bearing_forks.curt_surface: Spin(6,4) contains Pati-Salam and an SU(3,2) route whose maximal compact is the SM group
load_bearing_forks.active_repo_surface: one-generation branching and maximal-compact algebra are representation-theoretic receipts; selection by the source action is open
load_bearing_forks.rule: subgroup containment or a maximal compact is not a selected low-energy gauge group

load_bearing_forks.curt_surface: Omega0 plus gamma-trace and gamma-traceless Omega1 pieces are labelled generations one, two, and three
load_bearing_forks.active_repo_surface: the decomposition is kinematic; the physical chiral index is grading-determined and the count datum P3 remains external
load_bearing_forks.rule: no decomposition, block count, or 16-dimensional representation label is a generation count

recap_steps.curt_claim: Start with a smooth four-manifold X and construct the fourteen-dimensional symmetric metric bundle Y.
Construct the GL(4,R) frame bundle and lift to a double cover to admit finite-dimensional spinor representations.
Observation maps are local sections of Y over X.
Construct TY and T*Y.
Split TY into the canonical vertical bundle and a connection-dependent horizontal bundle.
Use the Zorro construction to pass from a section/metric choice to a Levi-Civita-type connection on the metric bundle.
Define the chimeric bundle C=V direct-sum H*.
Use the Frobenius inner product on symmetric matrices to metrize vertical fibres.
Split symmetric tensors into trace and traceless parts and choose the trace-reversed signature, reported as vertical (4,6) plus horizontal (1,3) giving (7,7).
Construct spinor bundles on the chimeric bundle using the direct-sum tensor-product property.
For the source Spin(7,7) presentation, the real Dirac spin module has dimension 128 and real half-spin modules dimension 64; complexification gives 128-complex full and 64-complex half-spin modules.
Use a principal U(64,64)-type spinor bundle.
Define the inhomogeneous gauge group as gauge transformations semidirect ad-valued one-form translations.
Specify the right action of the inhomogeneous group on the affine space of connections.
Define augmented torsion from the endpoint connection and a gauge-rotated Levi-Civita reference.
Introduce the Shiab as a gauge-equivariant curvature contraction generalizing Einstein contraction.
Formulate a first-order GU action with Einstein-Hilbert/Chern-Simons-like structure and a quadratic distortion term.
Vary the action to obtain equations analogous to Einstein and Yang-Mills.
Add fermions in Omega0(Y,S) direct-sum Omega1(Y,S) with a Dirac-Rarita-Schwinger operator.
Construct a deformation complex whose cohomology classifies gauge-inequivalent linearized fluctuations.
A seesaw structure in the Dirac-Rarita-Schwinger complex explains light/heavy spinor mixing and mass hierarchy.
Reduce Spin(7,7) to Spin(1,3) times Spin(6,4), then through Pati-Salam or SU(3,2) routes toward the SM gauge group.
Label the Omega0, gamma-trace Omega1, and gamma-traceless Omega1 pieces as three generations.
A scalar part of the pulled-back variational one-form pi is identified with the Higgs.
The trace of Sym2 is Higgs-like while the traceless part is graviton-like.
Curvature expansion produces a quartic and quadratic scalar potential of Mexican-hat form.
Minimal coupling to a connection containing a Higgs component yields Yukawa-shaped interactions.
Higgs and Yang-Mills terms share an origin in the decomposition and curvature of the variational connection.
A quadratic augmented-torsion term is required for full gauge covariance, analogous to Yang-Mills self-interaction.
A constant component of the pulled-back gauge potential is identified with an effective cosmological term.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Pulling fields on Y back along an observation section supplies the four-dimensional physical fields.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Complete C1/G4 before any recovered-equation label.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: The vertical reduction contains a 16-dimensional one-family packet matching Standard Model quantum numbers.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Use the 16 as a branching target and charge audit, never as evidence of three families.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Pati-Salam and SU(3,2) routes contain the Standard Model group after further reduction or speciality.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Compute the action-selected stationary stabilizer and hypercharge before naming the SM gauge group.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: The SU(3,2) real form is said to avoid classic proton-decay problems of older GUT choices.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Require the selected representation, heavy mediators, baryon-number operators, and decay-amplitude calculation.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Three Dirac-Rarita-Schwinger pieces are each described as 16-dimensional generations.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Compute the physical chiral cohomology/index; preserve the exact gamma-trace ordering fork across source passages.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: A Higgs component of the connection makes minimal coupling Yukawa-shaped.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Derive the common incidence, but debit Curt's explicit arranged coupling, Yukawa constant, and normalization until the action fixes them.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Residual gauge-potential/generation rotations are identified with CKM, with PMNS obtained by an analogous lepton construction.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Construct two action-selected noncommuting mass operators and their residual-unitary mismatch before claiming mixing.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: A chimeric Dirac-Rarita-Schwinger operator is presented as the GU Dirac equation.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Derive the odd Euler operator, constraint propagation, current, and observation intertwiner on one closed domain compatible with the C0-selected reality/container structure; require right-H only if that reduction survives, and treat an independently required but absent right-H structure as a kill.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Trace/vertical scalar curvature terms are assembled into a nonlinear Klein-Gordon-like equation.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Treat as a proposed scalar-Hessian readout, not an Eric formula; derive principal symbol, kinetic sign, potential, and observation map.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Shiab-processed curvature plus cosmological and source terms is presented as a gauge-covariant Einstein-like equation upstairs.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Use dual trace reversal and C1/C2; require two TT modes, Einstein symbol, constraints, and universal stress coupling.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: A curvature action on Y is varied into a familiar effective Yang-Mills form, with Shiab processing in the GU account.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Compute the reduced Hessian, Ward transport, current, and F2 ablation before identifying Yang-Mills dynamics.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: A constant component of pi and the quadratic augmented-torsion completion are identified with an effective cosmological term.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Derive a conserved observation stress, stationary state, amplitude, and PP3 map without fitting DESI.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: Unobserved decoupled sectors and their possible high-curvature recoupling are left as open questions.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Keep dark matter distinct from the off-observation complement and derive the physical decomposition, gap, stress, and recoupling threshold.

cross_cutting_recovery_claims.curt_claim: The known fields and equations are described rhetorically as falling inevitably from the metric-bundle geometry.
cross_cutting_recovery_claims.directive: Retain every choice, reduction, action coefficient, domain, background, and observation map in the constraint-surplus ledger.

new_prerequisites: tautological musical map pi*T*X -> pi*TX followed by a natural connection split to TY
global lifted frame/spin and chimeric-bundle descent
explicit resolution of the signature and real-form forks
deformation-complex and seesaw tests inside the odd action rather than as labels
action-selected symmetry-breaking chain and flavour misalignment
two distinct scalar-identification tests: connection-scalar versus symmetric-fibre trace
atlas_integration.reordered_next_swing: C0: construct the Zorro/chimeric-to-gimmel metric, Clifford, and structure-group bridge plus only the minimal primitives needed for enumeration; then run the target-blind census on the surviving carrier, port only the surviving carrier-dependent G2/G3 machinery if required, and lift C1 before stationary-background and Hessian work.
atlas_integration.reason: C0 adjudicates whether the source (7,7)/U(64,64) and active (9,5)/Sp(32,32;H) systems are alternative presentations of one object or different carriers. Non-equivalence preserves the IG/cocycle/distortion/action grammar but forces the Hodge/Clifford/Krein/Shiab/Euler/Green/Ward machinery to be ported or recomputed. Every recovery claim then still depends on C1's algebraic Euler dual, separately typed Riesz adjoint, global domain, quotient, and action-selected stationary state.

nonclaims: No Standard Model gauge group is dynamically selected.
No three-generation count or chiral index is derived.
No physical Higgs doublet, Yukawa matrix, CKM matrix, or PMNS matrix is derived.
No Einstein, Yang-Mills, Dirac, or Klein-Gordon equation is recovered on a physical four-dimensional domain.
No cosmological amplitude, equation of state, dark-matter abundance, or proton-decay prediction is derived.
